corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel
import socketio

class AnnouncementPayload(BaseModel):
    title: str
    message: str

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/communities")

@router.post("/{community_id}/announcements/broadcast")
async def post_community_announcement(
    community_id: str,
    payload: AnnouncementPayload,
    request: Request,
    user: User = Depends(get_authenticated_user)
):
    community_repo = request.app.state.community_repo
    community = await community_repo.get_by_id(community_id)
    if not community:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Community not found")
    if community.owner_id != user.id and not await community_repo.is_community_admin(community_id, user.id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: only community admins may broadcast announcements")

    sio: socketio.AsyncServer = request.app.state.socketio_server
    await sio.emit(
        "new_announcement",
        {"community_id": community_id, "title": payload.title, "content": payload.message, "author": user.username},
        room=f"community_{community_id}",
        namespace="/notifications"
    )
    return {"status": "broadcast_dispatched", "community_id": community_id}
